AIR FLOW

Side view of the throttle bore with air flowing horizontally. Closed: the plate is vertical, ends at 0° and 180°. Wide open: the plate turns counter-clockwise to horizontal, ends at 270° and 90°. Orange shows the angle the plate has turned.

Enable the smart key to simulate a sensor fault. Actual sensor readings remain visible.

TPS learning

Turn the TPS knob fully closed and press Learn closed, then fully open and press Learn wide-open, like an ECU throttle-position reset. The endpoints are saved on the ESP32 and survive power cycles.

Endpoints unavailable until live data arrives.

Sensor measurements

Sensor tiles show AIT and ECT in °C, O₂ as lambda (λ), MAP in kPa and TPS in %. AIT and ECT use an NTC thermistor model and MAP a linear model, both fitted to the client specification points. O₂ uses the client encoding λ = volts, AFR = 14.7 × λ. Values beyond the specification are still shown and marked; — means an open or shorted sensor circuit.
